property.name: categoriesDocument
property.value:
# Project Categories
## Retrospective No direct interactions with individual participants.
### Negligible Risk
#### Retrospective Data - De-identified data from repository - Identifiable data from repository
#### Retrospective Biospecimen - Anonymous cell lines - De-identified biospecimens from repository - Identifiable biospecimens from repository
## Prospective Observational Minimal direct interactions with non-patient or patient participants.
### Minimal Risk
#### Surveys / Education - Anonymous surveys - Identifiable surveys (non-sensitive data) - Research involving non-patient healthcare providers and educators
### More than Minimal Risk
#### Sensitive Data / Clinical Interactions - Identifiable surveys (sensitive data) - Vulnerable populations - Participant interactions limited to blood testing, imaging, etc.
## Prospective Interventional Health-related interventions involving non-patient or patient participants.
### More than Minimal Risk
#### Lower Risk - Benign behavioural interventions - Trials and other studies testing standard-of-care (SOC) products or techniques
#### Higher Risk - Clinical trials involving experimental products

property.name: taskLabel
property.value: Classify this study using the Project Categories.

property.name: prompt
property.value: - Classify this study using the Project Categories. - Return the best matching project_category, risk_level, and subcategory. - Support the classification with direct evidence from the study. - If this chunk does not contain enough information to classify, return found_answer=false for classification.

property.name: prompt
property.value: - The study title is usually located on the cover page, application summary, protocol title section, or research project title field. - Prefer the official protocol title. - If both a short title and full title exist, return the full title. - Prefer titles that describe the research project. - Ignore file names, document names, generic headers, footers, version labels, and form titles unless no official study title exists. - Do not invent a title. - If no title is present in this chunk, return found_answer=false for study_title.

property.name: prompt
property.value: - The Principal Investigator is usually located on the study team page, application form, investigator information section, signature page, or REB submission form. - The PI may appear as Principal Investigator, PI, Principal Applicant, Lead Investigator, Qualified Investigator, Study Chair, or Principal Researcher. - Prefer the individual explicitly identified as responsible for the study. - Return the person's full name exactly as written. - Exclude credentials from the value field unless they are part of the displayed name. - Do not return research coordinators, co-investigators, students, sponsors, institutions, departments, or study teams unless no individual PI can be identified. - If multiple names are listed, select only the person explicitly identified by one of the PI-equivalent roles. - If no PI can be determined from this chunk, return found_answer=false for principal_investigator.
